Guest FAQ

Straight answers — the same clarity we expect from captains on the dock.

Is this a discount aggregator?

No. GCCN is a curated premier network. We screen operators for guest experience, weather integrity, and stewardship — not for who will take the lowest seat price.

Per person or per trip?

Most private fishing and yacht products are per trip. Dolphin eco seats, some semi-private offshore, jet ski, and parasail use per-person or per-ski pricing — shown clearly on each listing.

How do deposits work?

Typically 25–40% holds your date. Stripe checkout is scaffolded but disabled until secrets are set; demo holds save locally. Balance is due before departure per operator policy.

What if weather is unsafe?

Green / Yellow / Red protocol. Red cancellations transfer deposits as credit to a new date. Yellow means stand by for a final morning call. Captain authority is final — that integrity is the product.

Do we get an itinerary?

Yes — a keepsake boarding pass with marina GPS, ceremonial checklist, weather banner, and deposit summary. Lookup by GCCN reference.

Spearfishing credentials?

Spear trips require listed dive certs. Sister brand Gulf Coast Spearfishing sets the safety bar we expect network spear operators to meet.

Kids & first-timers?

Many captains specialize in patient coaching (see family-first private 6-packs). Kids First Inshore and dolphin eco cruises are designed for younger guests.

Alcohol?

Vessel-dependent. Fishing and spear days usually prohibit alcohol underway. Sunset/private products may allow BYOB (no glass on many boats). Your captain's brief wins.

Tipping?

Customary 15–20% of trip total for captain and mate when the day is well run — handed dockside.

Licenses?

Alabama recreational saltwater licenses are typically guest responsibility unless the listing says the charter covers them. Verify ADCNR / federal rules for your trip type.
